source.snippet: "We are performing a migration from a legacy Salesforce Username-Password OAuth integration to an External Client App using Client Credentials. To validate migration behavior, we need the org-wide setting 'Allow OAuth Username-Password Flows' enabled."

problem_statement: Salesforce orgs undergoing legacy OAuth to Client Credentials migrations face opaque org-wide settings, feature flags, and edition restrictions that block migration validation and force support escalations, adding cost and delay to enterprise integration projects.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and integration engineers at consultancies or enterprise IT teams migrating legacy connected apps.
notes: Buyer signal: migration work is billable — the organization is paying consultants or internal engineers to perform this. The friction (needing Salesforce Support confirmation for a settings change) implies repeated cost across many orgs facing the same transition. A migration-readiness checker or guided migration tool for Salesforce OAuth transitions would have enterprise buyers.
